player_prompt.intro:
D kečč imiraz {player_id} yetturaren tamurt n Pig Dice.

Tisertiyin:
- Di tawmirt-ik, tzemreḍ ad tekkes '[roll]' neɣ '[hold]'
- Kkes 2-6: Rnu ɣer tawmirt-ik tamezwarut
- Kkes 1: Ttuḍ tawmirt-ik tamezwarut dɣa taweḍ tawmirt
- Hold: Rnu tawmirt-ik tamezwarut ɣer ussirem-ik dɣa taweḍ tawmirt
- Amenzu i {winning_score} n wučči yernu

Maca tawmirt-ik, tzemreḍ ad twaliḍ tisertiyin tura dɣa tawmirt tamezwarut.
Ssuter s '[roll]' ad tkkes tifelwa neɣ '[hold]' ad tbankem wučči-ik.

invalid_move.invalid_action: Tafyirt n uɣmisen ur tesɛi ṭṭajat. Sken '[roll]' neɣ '[hold]'.
